observation: Builder src/render/opticCellPresentation.js. Metal has its own cached hammered icosahedron from buildOpticMirrorGeometry (lines 89-108) served through opticCellGeometry('metal') under key 'optic:mirror' (123); visualFactory.js:2647 therefore skips the displaced-common-rock geometry entirely (JS short-circuit). Body material is one cached 'optic:body:metal' MeshStandardMaterial (lines 162-175): full metalness 1.0, roughness 0.11, envMapIntensity 2.3, so it reads as the mirror role distinct from stone/diamond/spent (module header 6-20). No facet inclusions: opticCellDetailMaterial returns null for metal (293-297), so dressOpticDetails adds nothing (313-336) and the cell stays a single body mesh (test/optic-materials.test.mjs:131, 138). variantIdx is computed at visualFactory.js:2642 but metal ignores it by design (248-259), so all metal cells share the same geometry/material pair, including the instance pool warm row (opticCellPoolResources 409-415; visualFactory.js:4599-4604). LOD: no body swap; no details to hide.
decision: No construction change recommended; single shared geometry and material, no per-cell allocation beyond the body mesh and group. Recommend needs follow-up until a current render exists.
next: Needs a current gameplay-scale and close capture of a metal cell beside stone and diamond (ceres prism gallery / swarm arena) plus practical draw cost; source-only evidence is not visual acceptance.
